# Psalm 63 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 63:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-psalm of-David, when-he-was in-the-wilderness of-Judah.
- **LOGOS:** A psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
- **PNEUMA:** A psalm of David, regarding the time he was in the wilderness of Judah.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 63:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** So in-the-sanctuary I-have-beheld-You, seeing Your-power and-Your-glory.
- **LOGOS:** So I have looked upon You in the sanctuary, beholding Your power and glory.
- **PNEUMA:** I have seen You in Your sanctuary and gazed upon Your power and glory.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** So I-bless-You in-my-life; in-Your-name I-lift-up my-hands.
- **LOGOS:** So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift up my hands.
- **PNEUMA:** I will praise You as long as I live, lifting up my hands to You in prayer.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 63:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** As-with marrow and-fatness my-soul is-satisfied, and-with-lips of-shouts-of-joy my-mouth praises.
- **LOGOS:** My soul will be satisfied as with fat and rich food, and my mouth will praise You with joyful lips,
- **PNEUMA:** You satisfy me more than the richest feast. I will praise You with songs of joy.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** My-soul clings to-You; Your-right-hand upholds-me.
- **LOGOS:** My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
- **PNEUMA:** I cling to You; Your strong right hand holds me securely.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 63:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** But-those-who seek my-soul for-destruction — they-go to-the-depths of-the-earth.
- **LOGOS:** But those who seek to destroy my life shall go down into the depths of the earth;
- **PNEUMA:** But those plotting to destroy me will come to ruin.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
